The <b>Growstone</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Consumables|consumable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is exclusive to [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]].

== Use ==
The Growstone generates [[Shell Shards]] over time, indicated visually by four growth stages. It will grow by one stage when [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] rests at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] after 20 minutes of active gameplay have passed (not while paused, in the inventory, or loading).<ref group=Code><code>GrowstoneState</code> incremented in <code>Gamemanager.TimePasses()</code>.</ref>

Shell Shards can be collected by using the Growstone from the inventory, which shatters and reverts back to growth stage 1. The item is reusable and cannot be destroyed.

== How to Acquire ==
The Growstone can only be acquired in [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]] by finding [[Steel Seer Zi]] inside a hidden cave within [[Blasted Steps]], and completing her [[Wishes#Unique Wishes|Wish]] <i>[[A Vassal Lost]]</i>.
